title: Scale
subtitle: HealthSense BS191

card.title: Scale
card.body: Weigh in on your HealthSense scale and save weight and body fat to Pulse.

status.noBluetooth: This phone has no Bluetooth LE
status.notAvailable: Bluetooth is not available in this build

forgetBody: Pulse will stop remembering this scale. You can search for it again.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.note: Pulse needs Nearby devices to find and connect to the scale. Nothing leaves the phone.

reading.title: This weigh-in
reading.waiting: Step on the scale with bare feet.
reading.noComposition: No body composition this time. A weigh-in with socks saves weight only.
reading.missingHeight: Add your height in Settings › Profile to see body composition.
reading.invalid: This reading is outside the range Pulse can use for body composition. Weight can still be saved.

history.title: Past weigh-ins
history.none: No past weigh-ins on the scale.
history.note: Weigh-ins stored on the scale are added to Pulse at the time they were taken.

athlete.title: Athlete mode
athlete.hint: The scale uses different body-composition coefficients for athletes. Turn this on only if you train like an athlete; Pulse never infers it from your activity.

settings.title: Scale
settings.athleteHint: Use the athlete coefficient group for body composition. Pulse never infers this from your activity.
settings.note: Pulse connects to the scale over Bluetooth only while the scale screen is open. Nothing leaves the phone.

profileNote: Body composition uses the sex, age and height in your profile. It is an estimate, not a medical measurement.

error.notAScale: This device does not expose the scale service.
error.needsNearby: Pulse needs the Nearby devices permission.
error.needsLocation: Android needs location services for a Bluetooth scan.
error.noScaleFound: No scale found. Make sure it is awake and nearby.
error.btUnavailable: Bluetooth is not available in this build.

health.title: Health Connect
health.ready: Weight and body fat are added to Health Connect. Google Fit and other health apps can read them.
health.permission: Saved in Pulse. Allow Health Connect writes so Google Fit and other apps can see the weigh-in.
health.unavailable: Health Connect is not available on this phone.
health.failed: Saved in Pulse. The Health Connect write failed.
health.note: Pulse writes only the scale's weight and body fat, tagged as Pulse. No Google account is used.
